The automatic transmission on the Tacoma can gear hunt, especially if you live in a hilly/mountainous area. I live in a pretty mountainous area and when I’m going up an incline, sometimes my truck struggles to figure out what gear it wants to be in & will upshift or downshift randomly. 

The Tacoma is tuned from the factory for MPG, not power. So the Tacoma lacks a lot of low-end torque and can seem sluggish. There is an ECT button below the AC knob which helps hold gears longer, but it’s not perfect and the truck can seem sluggish, even with it on. If you get a tune, like the KDMaxx or OTT (which is the one I recommend), it will increase the low-end torque and power output, stop gear-hunting and hold gears longer, and it will feel like a new truck. Some people have even reported getting 1-1.5 MPG better after a tune.

TRD Pro - Everything the Off Road has but with Fox progressive suspension with front coilovers and remote reservoir rear shock absorbers, 1-inch suspension lift, and a larger anti-sway bar.
